ValidationRule.description: This validation rule will ensure all fields necessary for an ACH Payment to be processed have a value.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.User_Developer_Name__c='NF_Automation_User'), OR( ISBLANK(Receiving_Company_Name__c), ISBLANK(Payee_s_Bank_Name__c ), ISBLANK(TEXT(Payee_s_Account_Type__c)), ISBLANK(Amount__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The following fields need to be populated for a successful ACH Payment to be processed: Receiving Company Name, Payee's Bank Name, Payee's Account Type and Amount.
